              2 ^ ((k + 1) - j) * Nat.choose ((k + 1) + j) j) +
          (2 ^ ((k + 1) - (k + 1)) *
            Nat.choose ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) (k + 1)) := by
      simpa using
        (Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (Nat.zero_le k)
